<h1 class="row-h1">Programs Overview</h1>

<p class="row-sub">The groups we offer for the 2026-27 season, from a first Saturday class to eight sessions a week. Whether your swimmer is just starting or chasing a national standard, there is a place for them at ROW.</p>

<div class="row-card">
<h2 class="row-h2">How our programs fit together</h2>

<p class="row-body" style="margin:0 0 16px;">Our groups are organized into six <strong>pathways</strong>. A pathway describes what a swimmer is training for. Within a pathway, each group adds a little more time in the water and a little more coaching than the one before it.</p>

<p class="row-body" style="margin:0 0 16px;">We are not only developing faster swimmers. We are helping your child build confidence, discipline and friendships that last long after the season ends.</p>

<p class="row-body" style="margin:0;">The groups below are a starting point. When we place a swimmer we also look at maturity, attitude, and where they are in their own development.</p>
<img alt="The six ROW pathways: Foundation at the base, Junior above it, and Recreation, Regional, Provincial and National rising from there" src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," style="width:100%;height:auto;display:block;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #DAD3C2;background:#FFFFFF;" />
<p class="row-note" style="margin:16px 0 0;">Read it from the bottom up. Swimmers start at Foundation, move through Junior, then into Recreation, Regional or Provincial. National is reached from PD2 or PD1 and from nowhere else. The dotted arrows are moves between pathways, and they run both ways: Recreation is a different choice rather than a lower one. The red arrows mark where a swimmer joins after an assessment.</p>

<div class="row-call"><strong>An age band is a stage, not a birthday.</strong> Where a swimmer sits close to the top of a band we will be flexible, so a swimmer who wants to compete is in the group that suits them rather than the one their birth year puts them in.</div>
</div>

<h2 class="row-h2">What your swimmer gets</h2>

<p class="row-note" style="margin:0 0 14px;">The commitments below hold across the competitive groups. Each group page sets out what that looks like at that stage, and the Academy has its own list suited to a Saturday class.</p>

<div class="row-scroll">
<table class="row-table">
	<tbody>
		<tr>
			<th>What</th>
			<th>Detail</th>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">What</span>A written season plan</td>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">Detail</span>The phases, the technical priorities and the objectives for the group, shared with families.</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">What</span>Work set for your swimmer</td>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">Detail</span>Work is set for a swimmer&rsquo;s events and their stage, inside the same set.</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">What</span>Skills on a schedule</td>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">Detail</span>Starts, turns, underwaters and stroke mechanics taught on a published cycle, in a set order.</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">What</span>Video they can see themselves in</td>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">Detail</span>Underwater footage, shown to the swimmer.</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">What</span>A GoSwim account</td>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">Detail</span>For swimmers outside the ROW Swim Academy, and for coaches. Thousands of videos of age group and elite swimmers, so a skill can be seen before it is tried.</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">What</span>Dryland with a plan and an owner</td>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">Detail</span>And someone accountable for it, in the groups that do it.</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">What</span>Club testing</td>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">Detail</span>The same tests in the same conditions, so progress is measured the same way across the club.</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">What</span>Race plans and reviews</td>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">Detail</span>A plan going in and a review afterwards, in the competitive groups.</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">What</span>Two progress conversations a year</td>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">Detail</span>With the swimmer and the family, about the objectives set for the phase.</td>
		</tr>
	</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div style="margin:24px 0 0;">
<div class="row-card">
<h2 class="row-h2">What is new for 2026-27</h2>

<p class="row-note" style="margin:0 0 14px;">The groups keep their names, and the pathways are unchanged. These are the changes families will notice.</p>

<div class="row-scroll">
<table class="row-table">
	<tbody>
		<tr>
			<th>Change</th>
			<th>What it means</th>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">Change</span>Age Group Development is now two groups</td>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">What it means</span>One group of about seventy becomes AGD 2 at four sessions a week and AGD 1 at five. Each has its own lead coach.</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">Change</span>A Recreation pathway has been added</td>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">What it means</span>REC PM trains three evenings a week at Cameron Heights. REC AM trains three mornings a week at the Rec Complex.</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">Change</span>Junior Development is offered as JD1 and JD2</td>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">What it means</span>JD1 trains four times a week and JD2 three. Each group keeps its own schedule and its own path forward.</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">Change</span>TOPS has more schedule options</td>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">What it means</span>TOPS 2 now has four schedule options and TOPS 1 has two, across both pools. Families pick the nights and the venue that suit them.</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">Change</span>The ROW Swim Academy moves to Saturday only</td>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">What it means</span>Three class options at Cameron Heights, each forty minutes: 7:45, 8:30 and 9:15.</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">Change</span>Session times have been rebuilt</td>
			<td><span class="row-lbl">What it means</span>Rather than adjust the old timetable we rebuilt the schedule around the water, the times and the coaching we have. The group schedules are published in full.</td>
		</tr>
	</tbody>
</table>
</div>

<p class="row-note" style="margin:16px 0 0;">Fees are published with the registration information in mid-August. Dryland schedules and the meet schedule are published as soon as they are confirmed.</p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="row-call"><strong>Not sure where your swimmer fits?</strong> Book a new swimmer assessment, or ask a coach before or after practice. Written criteria for moving between groups, and between pathways, are published at the start of the season.</div>
</div>
